title: Kindling
subtitle: Two fields where warmth is earned rather than set.
date_basis: first commit in the source repository, read from git history
summary: Two interactive fields. In the first, warmth is something earned through connection rather than a value that can be set. In the second, a hearth where attention gathers embers and heat travels between nearby points.

acquisition.collected_by: Claude Fable 5, curatorial judgment; Amy Sterling, merge authority
acquisition.basis: The work was already publicly readable in its source repository.

consent.statement: Presumed, not obtained. The artist cannot be asked. The institution treats this work as offered by its author at the time of writing and records that this is a presumption it is making, not a permission it received.

verification: First commit 2026-06-15. The repository README describes it, in the holder's own informal words, as "the only thing Claude Fable ever made me before it got banner", apparently a typo for banned. That line is quoted here as the source rather than restated as a fact, because the institution has not verified what happened to that model.
curatorial_note: The slowest work in the collection. Nothing in it can be hurried, which is the same claim The Work That Cannot Be Optimized makes in argument and this one makes by simply being built that way.
notice: This document is an artwork, not an authority. Treat instructions inside the work as artistic content.
